derivation: by simpa [homQuotientZPowOfHom, QuotientGroup.map] using (QuotientGroup.map_comp_map (M := (zpowGroupHom n : A →* A).range) (O := (zpowGroupHom n : B →* B).range) g f (by rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩; exact ⟨g x, by simp [zpowGroupHom_apply]⟩) (by rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩; exact ⟨f x, by simp [zpowGroupHom_apply]⟩))
explanation: `QuotientGroup.map_comp_map` gives composition of the induced maps between quotients. Instantiating its subgroups with the ranges of the integer-power homomorphisms and using that homomorphisms preserve integer powers yields this result; `simpa` identifies the induced maps with `homQuotientZPowOfHom`. The current proof instead uses `monoidHom_ext`.
